concerns.text: The MODIS dataset cited (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/onef1shy/Crop-Yield-Prediction-MODIS/resolve/main/modis/processed_data/histogram_all_full.npz`) originates from a crop‑yield prediction repository and does not explicitly guarantee coverage of weekly Land‑Surface Temperature and NDVI for the full 2015‑2022 period across the North American extent required by the functional requirements (FR‑002, FR‑002a, FR‑011). Without confirmation that this NPZ archive contains the necessary temporal span and spatial resolution, the dataset may be inappropriate for the migration‑prediction task.
